resources.string: This device is ready to be your computer\'s screen.
Plug in the cable. This needs USB debugging on this device (Settings › Developer options; if you don\'t see Developer options, tap Settings › About phone › Build number 7 times).

Join the same Wi-Fi network as the computer: this device appears in EkranLink there. The first time, click Connect on the computer and confirm the same code on both screens.\nThis device\'s address: %1$s
%1$s found this device. On the computer, click Connect (or the \"New device found\" notification), then confirm the same code on both screens.
%1$s is looking for this device. To add it, tap \"Add a new computer\" below.
Visible to new computers on this network · %1$s
This device is not connected to a Wi-Fi network. You can connect over USB.
Open automatically when plugged into a computer
In EkranLink on the computer, \"Connect automatically\" must also be on
A computer this device doesn\'t know tried to connect. To add it, tap \"Add a new computer\".
Pairing was not confirmed. To try again, click Connect on the computer.
Tap with three fingers for the menu
While connected, tap the screen with three fingers for the menu: rotate the screen, connection details, Disconnect.
Port %1$d is used by another app; will connect once it closes
EkranLink on the computer is newer: install the new version of EkranLink on this device
EkranLink on the computer is outdated: install the new version of EkranLink on the computer
To close, tap with three fingers again or press Back
%1$s wants to send its screen to this device.
Accept if it matches the code shown on the computer.
Tap to return to the screen
